description: Left the Monday ink for Monday, and set three trenchers.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Refused a second sermon, and named dinner at threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat his pew. He did not speak, and no sword-bearer stood behind him.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Held to yesterday's one glass, and would not write a feast in.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Agreed the almanac was blank, and left the vault for another day.
name: William Shakespeare
